purpose: Freeze deterministic advanced-data feature semantics, provenance, temporal-use classes, confidence and abstention rules before any predictive experiment or production integration.

temporal_classifications.PREGAME_HISTORICAL_DERIVABLE: A named aggregate or summary computed only from completed observations strictly prior to target kickoff. Target-game observation is forbidden.
temporal_classifications.TARGET_GAME_POST_KICKOFF: Value exists only after target game begins. It may be raw laboratory geometry and may only reach future pregame work through a separate named strict-prior aggregate.
temporal_classifications.RETROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION_ONLY: Outcome-window or official retrospective semantic label reserved for validation, QA, descriptive benchmarks or future separately-authorized work; prohibited as a V1 pregame predictor.

global_semantic_rules: Nearest defender is geometric proximity only and never exact coverage responsibility.
pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer is blocked-player/blocking-interaction identity, not a universal primary blocker-rusher assignment.
BDB2026 team coverage labels are play/team semantics and do not identify individual defender responsibility.
BDB2026 post-release defender metrics use only official player_to_predict output defenders and must abstain when that output scope contains no defender.
No sportsbook or market input is permitted anywhere in this feature layer.
Raw Kaggle competition CSV/video files remain ephemeral in GitHub Actions and are not committed to the repository.
Any pregame field must exclude the target game and use only completed strictly-prior observations.
No predictive experiment, model retune, or production promotion is authorized by this dictionary.
